limitations: Targeted gap search, not an exhaustive systematic review of every journal/venue.
No-paper-found is not proof of novelty; missing venue-specific evidence cannot support a universal absence claim.
Version-pinned author text may differ from camera-ready; peer-review status is separate from reviewed text.
2026 preprints are not automatically peer-reviewed. Workshop/Findings tracks are explicitly distinguished.
Code links and dataset names do not imply locally verified runnable assets.
